additional_context: source/fhir.ini routes datatypes to the active datatypes page, and current source/datatypes.html still includes the optional-milliseconds sentence alongside later approved ISO 8601 and timezone-offset wording. The linked Zulip thread confirms the original ambiguity, MnM minutes confirm the Persuasive vote, and later related datatype issues such as FHIR-42984 clarify instant precision without superseding the FHIR-32883 dateTime wording.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source hunk was needed because the current source already conveys the approved dateTime precision clarification; expanding the separate time primitive row or changing the wording to broader fractional-second prose would exceed the final FHIR-32883 resolution.
